label: HIRE
jd: Senior AI Engineer: build and own RAG pipelines and vector search, deploy services on Kubernetes, mentor junior engineers.
resume:
Software Engineer, 4 years
- Maintained the search backend for an internal knowledge app
- Fixed production incidents and improved index recall
Skills: Python, FastAPI, Kubernetes
transcript:
Interviewer: Walk me through how vector indexing works in your search backend.
Candidate: We used HNSW in FAISS, which builds a layered graph so a query hops from coarse to fine neighbours. When recall dropped I raised efSearch and rebuilt with a higher M, then measured recall against a brute-force baseline.
Interviewer: Tell me about a hard production bug.
Candidate: Two workers wrote to the index at once and corrupted it. I reproduced it with a stress script, found the missing lock, added a single-writer queue, and wrote a postmortem for the team.
Interviewer: How do you work with teammates?
Candidate: I pair with juniors on reviews and explain why I suggest changes, and I ask the team when I'm unsure.
